scope: Global water indicators for the future water.html page.
missing_data_policy: No values are inferred, interpolated or filled. Missing observations are absent; null is reserved for an explicitly published non-numeric value.
geography_note: Geographies use UN M49 codes and labels exactly as returned by the source API. water-countries.json contains only nodes classified as Country in the official UN SDG GeoArea Tree (including territories); water-timeseries.json also retains regional and global aggregates.

indicators.definition: Freshwater withdrawal by major economic sectors as a proportion of available renewable freshwater resources, after accounting for environmental flow requirements.
indicators.methodology: Ratio of total freshwater withdrawals to total renewable freshwater resources less environmental flow requirements, multiplied by 100.
indicators.estimation_flags: Use flags.nature and flags.observation_status on each observation. estimated=true for Nature=E or status E/I; provisional=true only for status P.
limitations: National averages can conceal basin-level and seasonal scarcity.
Country series may contain estimates or imputations and should not be read as direct measurements for every year.

indicators.label_pt: População que utiliza serviços de água potável geridos de forma segura
indicators.definition: Proportion of the population using an improved drinking-water source that is accessible on premises, available when needed and free from faecal and priority chemical contamination.
indicators.methodology: JMP compiles nationally representative sources and applies a standardized estimation methodology to produce internationally comparable annual estimates.
indicators.estimation_flags: Nature=E is marked estimated. JMP annual values are estimates and may differ from national statistics.
limitations: Safely managed estimates require data for accessibility, availability and quality; country availability is incomplete.
International estimates may differ from national estimates because definitions, inputs and population series differ.
This initial release retains total-population estimates only; rural and urban series are not included.
